text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple decode worker pods on gpu-pool-22 reporting CUDA OOMs during streaming decode. Request drops observed. Aggregated spike at 5167809950. Error signature: 'cudaErrorIllegalAddress / cuMemAlloc failed' in decode_loop.

liam_oncall: ack. seeing a surge of 5xx drops and container restarts. grabbing logs.

maya_sre: where are the affected pods? node list?

liam_oncall: 3 pods on node g2-23 (ip 10.44.23.7). crashloop with exit 137 and OOM lines.

eng-runtime-charlie: jump in — possible fragmentation/kv cache blowup. any unusual long generations?

liam_oncall: yes, telemetry shows sessions with extremely large token counts. upstream header X-Client-MaxTokens is missing for many requests. looks like a few customers sent repeated 'stream' sessions with no explicit limit.

support-jordan: customers A (CUST-4321) and B (CUST-998) reported truncated responses and missing completions. tickets linked: https://zendesk.example/tickets/4321, https://zendesk.example/tickets/998. Both report elevated latency then 5xx.

pm-olivia: priority customer A is on Dedicated cluster in this region. need quick mitigation and clear external comms.

liam_oncall: immediate plan: 1) cordon node g2-23, 2) scale up a spare node and drain sessions, 3) push temporary header enforcement at edge to cap max_tokens=1024, 4) evict long-running streams.

infra-til: scaling up now + adding node g2-24. draining 2 pods.

ops-bot: Deploy triggered by liam_oncall: enforce-max-tokens v1 -> edge-proxy. CI build id: 2026.03.15. Runbook step 3 executed.

eng-runtime-charlie: quick note: the runtime's KV cache keeps growing when clients stream without max_tokens. caching is per-session; fragmentation happens on repeated allocate/free on GPU with CUDA driver version 12.2. Suggested short-term: force session eviction and restart processes to defragment GPU heap.

liam_oncall: running command to list sessions on node g2-23:
```
# on node
ps aux | grep decode_worker
redis-cli -n 3 LRANGE session_heap 0 -1 | grep -E "session_id|tokens"
```
Found sessions with token_count > 20000.

maya_sre: evicting heavy sessions now. command:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/sessions/evict" -d '{"threshold_tokens":10000}' -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"
```
Evictions in progress.

eng-runtime-charlie: also patching runtime to reject requests with null/0 max_tokens. pushing a hotfix to runtime that treats missing max as default 512. This prevents unbounded loops. Hotfix will be canaryed to 10% of traffic for 5 minutes.

liam_oncall: canary applied. monitoring memory paths.

ops-bot: Canary traffic active -> runtime-hotfix-2026.03.15-rc1. 10% routes.

support-jordan: Customer A reports partial recovery — some requests succeeding but still intermittent drops. Ticket updated.

eng-runtime-charlie: observed immediate drop in per-pod GPU memory high-water mark for patched replicas. node g2-23 pods still crashed (need full restart).

liam_oncall: restarting pods on g2-23 now, then will rejoin after kubelet reports healthy.

maya_sre: note for postmortem: CUDA driver logs show repeated cudaMalloc retries failing with 'out of memory' followed by kernel OOM traces — matches fragmentation pattern.

pm-olivia: draft of customer comms: short incident update and mitigation steps, ETA for full root cause and timeline. I can send to account manager for A once we confirm stability.

liam_oncall: immediate mitigation status: edge enforcement active, hotfix canary healthy, heavy sessions evicted, node restarted, spare nodes added. Request drop rate reduced from 12% -> 1.8% in last 10m.

eng-runtime-charlie: recommending follow-ups: 1) permanent header enforcement + SDK default max_tokens, 2) improve telemetry to alert on per-session token growth, 3) upgrade CUDA drivers to 12.4 on next maintenance, 4) add periodic local defragmentation cycle in runtime.

maya_sre: creating incident channel and checklist for postmortem. will attach logs + kernel traces.

support-jordan: updating Customer A and B: initial mitigation active, some requests restored, full RCA and timeline to follow.

liam_oncall: final ops note: leaving edge enforcement in place for 24h, hotfix promoted to 100% in 15m after green metrics. Will monitor for regressions.

ops-bot: Promotion to 100% scheduled: 5167810400.

eng-runtime-charlie: promoted hotfix at 5167810410. no regressions seen after 10m.

maya_sre: last check: node g2-23 stable, memory profile normalized. closing active pager at 5167810800 pending postmortem.

liam_oncall: thanks team. follow-ups: postmortem owner = maya_sre, bug for SDK defaults = eng-runtime backlog, customer follow-up = pm-olivia + support-jordan.

pm-olivia: copy. I'll coordinate customer outreach and internal executive summary.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: root cause suspected heap fragmentation + unbounded streams due to missing max_tokens header -> GPU OOMs -> request drops. Sev: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation. Postmortem assigned.
